issues.suggested_fix: except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:  # Log instead of pass
issues.rationale: Silent exception swallowing hides errors and makes debugging impossible. Log specific exceptions instead.

issues.suggested_fix: except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:  # Specific exception
issues.rationale: Bare except clause catches all exceptions including KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit. Use specific exceptions.

issues.suggested_fix: except (KeyError, ValueError) as e:  # Catch specific exceptions
issues.rationale: Bare except clause is dangerous. Catch specific exceptions and log them for debugging.
